source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide when a simple pendulum has completed one oscillation.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: mean → right extreme → mean = one oscillation

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A pendulum cannot complete an oscillation when counting starts at an extreme position.

intelligence.enrichment: One oscillation is completed when the bob starts from the mean position, moves to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and returns to the mean position. Returning to the starting mean position after passing both extremes completes one repeat of the pendulum's path. The learner correctly applies this rule: One oscillation is completed when the bob starts from the mean position, moves to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and returns to the mean position. Any one-way swing or any return to the mean position counts as one complete oscillation.
